integrity: Recomputable from two complete standalone source files; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation for one six-vertex bidirected complete bipartite digraph; no global minimum or general classification asserted. Unindexed equivalent computations remain possible; signed Smith normal form and second geometric obstruction are supplied. The conjecture is cited as stated in the original 2022 preprint.
title: A six-vertex unstable multipath module with integral two-torsion
